subject: Quick favor with the event page?
text: Hi there, I hope you're having a calmer afternoon than mine has been. I've run into a small technical snag with the registration form for the neighborhood cleanup, and I'm hoping you can look it over when you have a few minutes. When I opened the setup email this morning, one instruction said to 'enable duplicate submissions for walk-ins,' but the dashboard only gives me a choice between allowing one response and blocking multiple responses. I clicked through every menu, tried the help tab, and even restarted the form, but the wording still seems impossible to match with what the page actually lets me do. My worry is that volunteers arriving late won't be able to sign up, which would make it harder for us to track attendance and assign the supply tables. If you have the extra seconds, could you tell me what setting you usually use in that situation, or maybe take a quick peek at the screen and let me know if I'm overlooking something obvious? I don't want to keep the page open with the wrong option chosen for the rest of the week, especially since the reminder notice goes out tomorrow evening. Thank you so much for always being patient with these glitches; I really appreciate you. I can send a screenshot if that would make it easier, and I can work around your schedule, since I know evenings are usually crowded with family plans. No rush at all, but if you notice anything simple, that would save me another headache.
